ENFORCEMENT COMPLETE: complete-architecture-separation

SPECIFICATION: The three-component architecture has clean separation: metabob-opencode (execution + coordination), metabob-cli (data collection + enrichment + gateway), metabob-rpc-api (ML training + metrics + storage).

=== CHANGES APPLIED ===

[CHANGE 1] CRITICAL: Deleted thompson-sampler.ts
File: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/ml/thompson-sampler.ts
Component: ThompsonSampler class (entire file, 451 lines)
Change Made: Deleted entire file containing Thompson Sampling implementation
Reason: Thompson Sampling is ML logic that must only exist in RPC API, not execution layer
Impact Analysis:
  - Removed 451 lines of ML code from opencode
  - Removed Beta distribution calculations (sampleBeta, sampleGamma)
  - Removed ModelArm storage interface
  - No dependencies found (template-selector.ts already refactored to use RPC API)
  - Zero breaking changes (file was no longer imported)
Architectural Impact: CRITICAL - Enforces clean separation between execution and ML layers

[CHANGE 2] MEDIUM: Removed Thompson Sampling calculations from activity.ts (first occurrence)
File: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/tool/activity.ts
Component: Activity tool metrics tracking (lines 1047-1056)
Change Made: Removed Thompson Sampling Beta distribution parameter calculations
  - Removed: const successCount = Math.round(newSuccessRate * newExecutions)
  - Removed: const failureCount = newExecutions - successCount
  - Removed: const thompsonAlpha = successCount + 1
  - Removed: const thompsonBeta = failureCount + 1
  - Removed: const allocationWeight = thompsonAlpha / (thompsonAlpha + thompsonBeta)
  - Replaced: allocationWeight now uses newSuccessRate directly (simple metric, no ML)
Reason: Metric calculation using ML formulas should happen in RPC API, not opencode
Impact Analysis:
  - Simplified allocationWeight calculation from Beta distribution to success rate
  - Removed 10 lines of ML calculation code
  - No breaking changes (allocationWeight still passed to updateMetrics)
  - RPC API can calculate true Thompson Sampling metrics in background
Architectural Impact: MEDIUM - Removes ML calculations from execution layer

[CHANGE 3] MEDIUM: Removed Thompson Sampling calculations from activity.ts (second occurrence)
File: repos/metabob-opencode/packages/opencode/src/tool/activity.ts

Reason: Metric calculation using ML formulas should happen in RPC API, not opencode

3. metabob-rpc-api: ML Training + Metrics + Storage

opencode → MCP call → CLI (api_client.py) → HTTP POST /api/templates/select

=== RIPPLE EFFECTS ===

1. thompson-sampler.ts was already unused (zero imports)
